about: Knights of the Frozen Throne's interface (docs/packs/format.md, 'UI theme'): Icecrown Citadel in Northrend — dark panels of steel-grey saronite with pale teal rims like glowing runes, buttons of deep frozen blue that light up icy teal under the mouse, frost-white text, the pale teal of the Lich King's runes for headings, blood red for danger and a cold green for confirmations, snow drifting over the menu; the title in Classic's Cinzel Decorative, in pale teal.
